verdict.rationale: Aider documents adding images and screenshots to the chat as visual context (aider-docs-22). It can generate new files from natural-language instructions (aider-docs-33, aider-docs-25) and run or test the resulting code (aider-docs-43, aider-docs-42), so an image-to-code workflow is plausible. However, image input gets only a single brief mention, and nothing shows it turning a design into a working app. Missing for 10: PDF design input, explicit sketch/design-to-app workflow docs, hands-on or independent evidence of generating a working app from an image.
